title: Austin Battles Houston Power Company
summary:
*   A special meeting was held entirely as a closed-door executive session.
*   The sole focus was discussing ongoing litigation involving the City of Austin.
*   A prominent lawsuit involved the City of Austin taking legal action against Houston Lighting and Power Company.
*   No public actions or policy decisions were made following the private session.
